hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecisionReason: `--no-verify` / `-n` bypasses the repo's `.githooks` gates (pre-commit / pre-push). Remove it and let the local gates run. `GSD_CONTRIB_OVERRIDE` does not lift this deny: this gate honors it only for a thrown gate error. Turning the toolkit off is a human operator's decision, not a way past this deny: `node bin/contrib-capability.cjs off --reason "<why>"`, run from the toolkit checkout, strips the toolkit's gates from that gsd-core checkout and writes a receipt. (ENF-12)
